By the way, please be sure to [[Help:Sign_your_posts_on_talk_pages|Sign your comments on talk pages]], using four tildes (&#126;&#126;&#126;&#126;) to produce your name and the current date, or three tildes (&#126;&#126;&#126;) for just your name. If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact one of us for more information!
==Use of Past/Present tense==
Please try to write from the perspective of the latest book.  Relating events that happened in previous books should use the past tense, but when describing things that are also true now, use the present tense.  Thanks! --[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 07:12, 10 August 2006 (UTC)
